title: Returned-Payment Fees on Credit Builder Accounts: When the Fee Is Owed and How It Is Booked
content:
## When the fee is owed

A returned-payment fee on a Credit Builder account is owed for the account's most recent returned payment, when its return code carries a fee, as soon as the return is booked. A Credit Builder returned-payment fee is charged once per returned payment and only for the account's most recent returned payment and only when that payment's return code is one of the plan's fee-bearing return codes (R01, R02, R03, R04, R08, R09, R16 and R20 on every Credit Builder plan), never for R07, R10, R29 or a chargeback, and its amount is figured as the Credit Builder Accounts returned-payment fee policy sets out rather than as the plan's flat returned-payment fee.

An earlier returned payment that is followed by a newer return before its own fee is charged carries no fee of its own, so a run of returns booked before the fee is charged costs one returned-payment fee.

| Most recent returned payment on the account | Returned-payment fee |
|---|---|
| return code R01, R02, R03, R04, R08, R09, R16 or R20, no fee yet charged for it | owed |
| return code R07, R10 or R29, or a chargeback (code CB) | none |
| a fee already charged for it | not charged again |
| an earlier return, followed by a newer one before its fee was charged | none for the earlier return |

## Booking the fee: `assess_returned_payment_fee_1f748b6c`

**What it does.** The tool charges one returned-payment fee to a Credit Builder account for one returned payment. It books a returned-payment fee entry on the borrower's Credit Builder account, dated today and linked to the returned-payment entry it is charged for, and adds the fee to the account's unpaid fees. The borrower sees the new fee and the higher unpaid-fee balance on the account.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_returned_payment_fee_1f748b6c` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `builder_account_id` | reference number of the Credit Builder account being charged, as returned by the Credit Builder account lookup |
| `related_txn_id` | reference number of the returned-payment entry the fee is charged for, as listed among the account's entries by the Credit Builder entry lookup |
| `returned_payment_fee_amount` | the returned-payment fee to charge in USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation of the form "Returned-payment fee <entry reference> of <amount> USD booked on <account reference> for returned payment <entry reference>; unpaid fees now <amount> USD.", where amounts are in USD with 2 decimal places and the unpaid-fee figure includes this fee. Receiving this text means the fee is on the account.
